reading.title: The Evolution of Renewable Energy
reading.passage: Renewable energy sources have become increasingly important in addressing global climate change. Solar and wind power technologies have advanced significantly over the past decade, reducing costs and improving efficiency. Many countries now invest heavily in renewable infrastructure to decrease reliance on fossil fuels. The transition to clean energy not only benefits the environment but also creates new job opportunities in the green technology sector. However, challenges remain in energy storage and grid integration.

questions.q: According to the passage, what has happened to solar and wind power technologies?
options: They have advanced and become more efficient
They are no longer used in most countries
They require more fossil fuels to operate
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'Solar and wind power technologies have advanced significantly over the past decade, reducing costs and improving efficiency'라고 명확히 나와있습니다. 따라서 태양광과 풍력 기술이 발전하고 효율성이 개선되었다는 것이 정답입니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is mentioned as a benefit of transitioning to clean energy?
questions.explanation: 'The transition to clean energy not only benefits the environment but also creates new job opportunities in the green technology sector'라는 문장에서 청정에너지로의 전환이 녹색 기술 부문에서 새로운 일자리 창출을 야기한다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What challenges are mentioned in the passage?
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 'However, challenges remain in energy storage and grid integration'이라고 직접 언급되어 있습니다. 에너지 저장과 그리드 통합이 남은 과제입니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Countries should prioritize renewable energy development over other economic investments'?

structure.intro: 먼저 주제를 명확히 하는 한 문장 정의 후, 자신의 입장을 분명하게 제시합니다. 예: 'While economic growth is important, I believe renewable energy should be prioritized...'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 논거: 환경 보호의 필요성 - 기후변화, 대기오염 감소 등의 장기적 이점을 설명합니다.
structure.body2: 두 번째 논거: 경제적 이점 - 신규 일자리 창출, 에너지 비용 절감, 기술 혁신 등을 구체적으로 제시합니다.
structure.conclusion: 두 논거를 종합하여 재신입하고, 미래 세대를 위한 투자 관점에서 마무리합니다.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in traditional office environments. Others prefer to work remotely from home. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer... because...
sample_points: 원격근무의 장점: 시간 절약, 업무 집중력 향상, 생활-업무 균형 개선 등을 언급할 수 있습니다.
원격근무의 추가 이점: 교통비 절감, 유연한 일정 관리, 가족과의 시간 증가 등을 구체적으로 설명합니다.

listening.title: University Library Orientation
listening.script: Librarian: Welcome to our university library. I'm here to help you get started. Student: Thank you! This is my first time here. Where should I begin? Librarian: Well, first you need a library card. It's free for all students. You just fill out this form with your student ID. Student: How long does that take? Librarian: Just a few minutes. After that, I can show you our computer databases. We have access to thousands of academic journals and research papers. Student: That's great! What about finding textbooks? Librarian: Textbooks are on the fourth floor in the reference section. You can search our online catalog to check availability. Most students reserve them for two-hour sessions to save costs. Student: I see. And what are the borrowing limits? Librarian: Students can borrow up to 20 books at a time for three weeks. However, reference materials cannot be borrowed; they must be used here in the library. Student: Got it. This is very helpful!

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To orient a new student about library services
To register for a computer class
questions.explanation: 대화의 전체 내용을 보면 사서가 처음 도서관에 방문한 학생에게 도서관 이용 방법, 자료 위치, 대출 규정 등을 설명하고 있습니다. 따라서 주된 목적은 신입생을 도서관 서비스에 대해 안내하는 것입니다.

questions.q: Where are textbooks located in the library?
questions.explanation: 사서가 'Textbooks are on the fourth floor in the reference section'이라고 명확히 말했으므로, 교과서는 4층에 위치합니다.

questions.q: What is the borrowing limit for students?
questions.explanation: 사서가 'Students can borrow up to 20 books at a time for three weeks'라고 설명했으므로, 학생들은 한 번에 최대 20권을 3주일 동안 대출할 수 있습니다.
